critical quality gate Download ExcelDownload PDF **18** Checkpoints **6** Sections Per waterproofing zone; typically per 100m² or daily QC Engineer, Waterproofing Contractor [IS 2645:1974](https://infralens.in/code/IS-2645-2003) [IS 3036:1992](https://infralens.in/code/IS-3036-1992) [IS 13410:1992](https://infralens.in/code/IS-13410-1992) Related [📐IS 2645](https://infralens.in/code/IS-2645) [✏️Concrete cover](https://infralens.in/thumbrules/concrete-cover-by-exposure) [📘Concrete Mix Ratios](https://infralens.in/handbook/concrete-mix-ratios) [📖Min cover for RCC](https://infralens.in/knowledge/minimum-cover-rcc-is-456) [🔧water-demand-lpcd-calculator](https://infralens.in/tools/water-demand-lpcd-calculator) ### Checklist Preview Expand all ↓ | S.No. | Checkpoint | IS Requirement | Status | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | A. STRUCTURAL INSPECTION | | A1 | Structure cured and strength achieved (minimum 28 days for RCC; minimum 7 days for plaster)
Acceptance: Concrete cube strength ≥20 N/mm² for bearing surfaces; plaster strength ≥2.5 N/mm² measured | Cl. 401 — Maturity requirement | | | A2 | Structural cracks >2mm sealed with epoxy injection or crack filler before waterproofing
Acceptance: Cracks >2mm injected with epoxy resin; cured per product spec; cracks <2mm acceptable | Cl. 401 — Crack treatment | | | A3 | Structural deflection settled; building movement (thermal/settlement) stabilized
Acceptance: No active cracks; settlement complete per structural engineer; documented observation period | Cl. 401 — Movement assessment | | | B. SURFACE CLEANING & PREPARATION | | B1 | Surface cleaned: Removal of dust, loose mortar, algae, fungi, dirt, debris
Acceptance: Wire brush/mechanical cleaning; vacuum removal of dust; no loose material >1mm; visual 100% | Cl. 401 — Cleaning requirement | | | B2 | Loose plaster removed; surface exposed to concrete; loose concrete removed by chipping
Acceptance: Delaminated plaster removed; exposed base surface strong; tapping confirms adhesion | Cl. 401 — Surface exposure | | | B3 | Surface roughness adequate for adhesion; smooth surfaces scarified or primed
Acceptance: CSP (Concrete Surface Profile) 2-3; adhesion promoter applied to smooth surfaces | Cl. 401 — Surface profile | | | B4 | Oil, grease, paint, previous coating removed; surface chemically clean if required
Acceptance: Degreaser wash for oily surfaces; visual inspection shows no sheen; clean towel test | Cl. 401 — Contaminant removal | | | C. MOISTURE & EFFLORESCENCE CONTROL | | C1 | Surface moisture content <5% measured by hygrometer; surface visually dry
Acceptance: Moisture meter reading <5%; no wet patches; surface dry to touch; wait 48 hrs if wet | Cl. 401 — Moisture control | | | C2 | Efflorescence removed by wire brushing; surface checked for re-appearance (24-48 hrs wait)
Acceptance: Brush away white salt deposits; no re-appearance within 48 hours; if returns, apply biocide | Cl. 401 — Salt removal | | | C3 | Rising damp assessed and treated if present; damp-proof course in place or repair planned
Acceptance: Damp detected <1m above ground → DPC repair required; surface treated with desiccant if needed | Cl. 401 — Damp assessment | | Showing 10 of 18 checkpoints ·View all → A. STRUCTURAL INSPECTION A1Structure cured and strength achieved (minimum 28 days for RCC; minimum 7 days for plaster) Cl. 401 — Maturity requirement (IS 2645) ✓ Concrete cube strength ≥20 N/mm² for bearing surfaces; plaster strength ≥2.5 N/mm² measured A2Structural cracks >2mm sealed with epoxy injection or crack filler before waterproofing Cl. 401 — Crack treatment (IS 2645) ✓ Cracks >2mm injected with epoxy resin; cured per product spec; cracks <2mm acceptable A3Structural deflection settled; building movement (thermal/settlement) stabilized Cl. 401 — Movement assessment (IS 2645) ✓ No active cracks; settlement complete per structural engineer; documented observation period B. SURFACE CLEANING & PREPARATION B1Surface cleaned: Removal of dust, loose mortar, algae, fungi, dirt, debris Cl. 401 — Cleaning requirement (IS 2645) ✓ Wire brush/mechanical cleaning; vacuum removal of dust; no loose material >1mm; visual 100% B2Loose plaster removed; surface exposed to concrete; loose concrete removed by chipping Cl. 401 — Surface exposure (IS 2645) ✓ Delaminated plaster removed; exposed base surface strong; tapping confirms adhesion B3Surface roughness adequate for adhesion; smooth surfaces scarified or primed Cl. 401 — Surface profile (IS 2645) ✓ CSP (Concrete Surface Profile) 2-3; adhesion promoter applied to smooth surfaces B4Oil, grease, paint, previous coating removed; surface chemically clean if required Cl. 401 — Contaminant removal (IS 2645) ✓ Degreaser wash for oily surfaces; visual inspection shows no sheen; clean towel test C. MOISTURE & EFFLORESCENCE CONTROL C1Surface moisture content <5% measured by hygrometer; surface visually dry Cl. 401 — Moisture control (IS 2645) ✓ Moisture meter reading <5%; no wet patches; surface dry to touch; wait 48 hrs if wet C2Efflorescence removed by wire brushing; surface checked for re-appearance (24-48 hrs wait) Cl. 401 — Salt removal (IS 3036) ✓ Brush away white salt deposits; no re-appearance within 48 hours; if returns, apply biocide C3Rising damp assessed and treated if present; damp-proof course in place or repair planned Cl. 401 — Damp assessment (IS 3036) ✓ Damp detected <1m above ground → DPC repair required; surface treated with desiccant if needed Showing 10 of 18 ·View all → Inspection Sign-Off APPROVED APPROVED WITH CONDITIONS REJECTED — RE-PREPARE Remarks Name / Sign / Date Inspected By Name / Sign / Date Reviewed By Name / Sign / Date ### More related 📐IS / IRC codes -
